#frame_bg_color: RGB base of the frosted-glass tint; MisaWM blends it semi-transparently over the blurred desktop
#frame_width: thickness of the frosted-glass border band; the glass border follows this exactly
#round: radius of the rounded frame corners, 0 = square
#frame_blur: xserverd keeps a clean per-window snapshot of what is below and hands it to xwm as the DRAW_FRAME desktop, so the frost blurs the real backdrop
